mapper.insert: INSERT INTO visit_log ( member_no, session_id, request_uri, query_string, request_method, user_agent, ip_address, referer, created_date ) VALUES ( #{memberNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{sessionId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{requestUri, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{queryString, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{requestMethod, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userAgent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ipAddress, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{referer, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visit_log v WHERE v.ip_address = #{ipAddress, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND v.created_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member m WHERE m.no = v.member_no AND m.role = 'ADMIN' )
